x-groups.title: Connection
x-groups.description: The server, and the user the destination signs in as.

addr.title: Address
addr.description: host:port of the server's native protocol: 9000, or 9440 with TLS.

user.title: User
user.description: The user to connect as. Its grants and settings profile are on the connector's page.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: Connect with TLS, verified against the system's roots, as the secure native port, 9440, needs.

database.title: Database
database.description: The database tables are written to when the pipeline names no namespace. Created if it doesn't exist and the user may. A database whose name has a dot can't take patches of held cells.
